# Layout (`layout`)

Flex-like container: direction, gap, padding, layers, sizing.

| | |
|--|--|
| **IR kind** | `layout` |
| **World A ctor** | `Layout(…)` |
| **Child-flex props** | Yes (when parent is `layout`) |


## Properties

| Property | Type |
|----------|------|
| `width` | Sizing — `.hug`, `.fill`, `.fixed(n)`, `.flex(…)`, `.aspect(…)` (number → `.fixed`) |
| `height` | Sizing — `.hug`, `.fill`, `.fixed(n)`, `.flex(…)`, `.aspect(…)` (number → `.fixed`) |
| `direction` | Direction — `.row`, `.column`, `.rowReverse`, `.columnReverse`, `.stack`, `.reverseStack` |
| `wrap` | Wrap — `.nowrap`, `.wrap` |
| `align` | Align — `.start`, `.center`, `.end`, `.stretch` |
| `justify` | Justify — `.start`, `.center`, `.end`, `.stretch`, `.spaceBetween`, `.spaceAround` |
| `gap` | Distance |
| `columnGap` | Distance |
| `rowGap` | Distance |
| `padding` | EdgeInsets — `EdgeInsets(…)` or uniform number sugar |
| `margin` | EdgeInsets — `EdgeInsets(…)` or uniform number sugar |
| `background` | Color | layer stack | Background | Foreground |
| `foreground` | Color | layer stack | Background | Foreground |
| `cornerRadius` | Radius | CornerRadii |
| `opacity` | Opacity |
| `overflow` | Overflow — `.visible`, `.scroll`, `.clip` |
| `shadow` | Shadow |
| `borderWidth` | number |
| `borderColor` | Color |
| `borderPosition` | BorderPosition — `.inside`, `.outside` |

## Child-flex properties

Available when this frame is a child of a `layout` (or as root flex against the host viewport):

| Property | Type |
|----------|------|
| `alignSelf` | AlignSelf — `.start`, `.center`, `.end`, `.stretch`, `.auto` |
| `grow` | number |
| `shrink` | number |
| `position` | Position — `.flow`, `.absolute` |
| `inset` | EdgeInsets — `EdgeInsets(…)` or uniform number sugar |

- `children` (structural)
